title: THE GOLDEN SCOOTER'S SECRET REVEALED! 🛴
topic: resolution of the stolen scooter mystery

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I KNOW YOU HAVE IT BRUNO [beat] I SAW THE GOLDEN REFLECTION PEAKING OUT FROM UNDER THAT OLD TARP IN YOUR GARAGE!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: STAY BACK NIX [beat] YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND THE MESS MY FAMILY IS IN AND HOW MUCH WE DESPERATELY NEEDED THAT MONEY!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: YOU ARE A PATHETIC THIEF BRUNO [beat] AND YOU WERE GOING TO LET DING TAKE THE FALL JUST TO SAVE YOUR OWN REPUTATION!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: MY DAD LOST HIS CONTRACT [beat] AND WE WERE GOING TO BE ON THE STREET BY MONDAY IF I DIDN'T FIND SOMETHING VALUABLE TO SELL!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: YOU COULD HAVE JUST ASKED ME FOR HELP [beat] INSTEAD OF DESTROYING YOUR CHARACTER AND STEALING THE ONLY THING I TRULY LOVED!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I WAS TOO EMBARRASSED TO ADMIT WE WERE TOTALLY BROKE [beat] AND NOW I'VE RUINED EVERYTHING BEYOND ANY CHANCE OF REPAIR!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: NOT QUITE EVERYTHING [beat] BECAUSE I ALREADY TOLD UNCLE JAMAL ABOUT YOUR SITUATION AND HE WANTS TO HIRE YOUR DAD IMMEDIATELY!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: WHY WOULD YOU POSSIBLY HELP ME [beat] AFTER I LITERALLY STOLE FROM YOU AND LIED TO YOUR FACE EVERY SINGLE DAY AT SCHOOL?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: NIX TOLD ME YOU WERE IN TROUBLE [beat] AND HE CONVINCED ME THAT A GOOD MANAGER IS MUCH HARDER TO FIND THAN A GOLD SCOOTER!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: KEEP THE SCOOTER BRUNO [beat] SELL IT AND PAY OFF YOUR BACK RENT SO YOUR FAMILY CAN FINALLY SLEEP PEACEFULLY AT NIGHT!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I DON'T DESERVE THIS AT ALL [beat] BUT I PROMISE TO SPEND THE REST OF MY LIFE PAYING BACK THIS UNBELIEVABLE DEBT OF HONOR!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: AND THAT IS HOW NIX PROVED [beat] THAT IN THIS WORLD KINDNESS IS THE ONLY CURRENCY THAT ACTUALLY BUYS YOU A COMPLETELY CLEAN SLATE!
